sector_survival_note: Mastercard has consistently demonstrated its ability to adapt to changing market conditions and maintain its market share.
thesis_summary: Mastercard's moat is its network effect and brand recognition, which allows it to ride the big trend of digital payments.
thesis_breaks_if: Short-term noise, ignore unless it structurally changes the next decade.
sentiment_note: Accumulate slowly due to rich valuation.
ten_k_highlights: Mastercard has a strong track record of revenue growth, with a 5-year CAGR of 73.6%
The company has a high return on invested capital (ROIC) of 59%, indicating efficient use of capital
Mastercard has a cash runway, with positive free cash flow and a low debt-to-equity ratio
valuation_note: FCF yield 3.6%, PEG 1.6, EV/EBITDA 22, P/S 14 — priced ahead of fundamentals — accumulate slowly.
implied_growth_note: The price assumes reasonable growth the business can likely deliver.
